summary: Execution capacity used by a job equals min(forks, hosts) + 1, so forks 5 on 50 hosts uses 6 units. Scale execution nodes vertically for more forks or horizontally into separate instance groups assigned to organizations, inventories or job templates; lower the capacity adjustment if monitoring shows over-use.
questions: How is job capacity calculated in automation controller?
How many capacity units does a job with 5 forks use?
How do I isolate low-priority jobs on separate execution nodes?
What is capacity adjustment on an execution node?

answer_card.title: How much execution capacity a job uses
answer_card.answer_md:
`capacity = min(forks, hosts in inventory) + 1`
Example: default forks 5 on 50 hosts uses **6** units. Control nodes use **1** unit per job. Add execution nodes into dedicated instance groups to keep low-priority jobs from blocking others.
